status.no_ai: Demo deployment: the AI memo, photo review and guideline search are switched off, so assessments use the rule engine only.

status.sample: All properties shown are sample data. No real customer data is used.

dash.title: Underwriting portfolio
dash.lead: Commercial property risks assessed, the decisions taken and where the exposure sits.
drivers.note: How many assessments raised each flag.
cat.title: Natural-catastrophe exposure
city.title: Concentration by city
pipeline.note_dev: Built nightly by the ELT pipeline: Postgres → Parquet → dbt on DuckDB (tested) → snapshot. Last run {time} UTC.
res.mitigation_note: Credit for protection in place. It shows how protection changes the indicative view; it is not an insurer-approved rate or tariff.
res.memo_ai_label: Drafted by AI from the rule engine's decision and the cited guidelines. The decision itself comes from the rules.
res.cited: Grounded in guideline sections {ids}, checked against what was retrieved.
res.refs_note: Synthetic reference properties, not verified market data.
rev.title: Your review is needed
rev.lead: The rules referred this property (score {score} / 100). The assessment is paused until you approve the referral or change the decision.
rev.lead_dev: The engine referred this property (score {score} / 100). The LangGraph run is paused at the human_review interrupt and resumes with your decision.
rev.note_ph: Why you approve or change it
new.title: New property assessment
new.lead: Enter the proposal and survey details. The risk preview updates as you type.
hint.coast: Under 1 mile adds a coastal wind and surge flag (+15 points)
hint.fire: Under 1 mile adds a wildfire-zone flag (+15 points)
cover.title: Requested cover and add-ons
cover.note: Select the cover and add-ons requested. Availability depends on the product. These choices inform the review and do not change the risk score.
values.note: The property sum insured is the total of the items below. Business interruption is separate.
upload.text: Click to upload or drag and drop
upload.hint: PNG or JPEG · one photo is reviewed per proposal
upload.multi: Several photos selected; the first one is reviewed.
q.title: Evaluation results
q.lead: Measured, not assumed: a golden set of {cases} properties covering every scoring rule and decision band, run in CI.
q.compare: TOON vs JSON: the same memo prompt in two formats
q.not_run: Generated-memo comparison not run yet (needs the Gemini key in CI).
q.note: Faithfulness is scored by a DeepEval LLM judge ({judge}) against the retrieved evidence. Contract pass means the memo kept the deterministic decision, cited only real risk flags and retrieved guideline sections, and invented no amounts or regulations.
int.title: MCP server and A2A agent
int.lead: The underwriting engine is usable by AI assistants (MCP) and by other agents (A2A), not only through this UI.
int.tool.assess_property: Score a property with the deterministic engine; returns decision, flags and breakdown.
int.tool.search_guidelines: RAG search over the underwriting guidelines (Gemini embeddings in Qdrant).
int.tool.get_assessment: Fetch a stored assessment with its review status and AI rationale.
int.tool.list_assessments: List assessments, optionally filtered by decision.
int.mcp_note: The resource uw://guidelines exposes the full guidelines. Add the URL as a remote MCP server in Claude, Copilot or any MCP client.
int.skill.assess_property: send property facts as a data part; get score, decision, review status and cited rationale.
int.skill.underwriting_guidance: ask in text; get the most relevant guideline sections.
int.tool.lookup_hazard: Official seismic zone, flood history and IMD cyclone grade for an Indian PIN code.
hz.title: Location hazard check
hz.none: No official hazard data for this PIN code. Check that it is a valid 6-digit Indian PIN code.
hz.understated: The proposal states Zone {declared}, but this PIN code is in Zone {official}, so the score uses Zone {official}.
hz.cyclone_none: Not one of IMD's 100 cyclone-prone districts
hz.note: Indicative, from public maps: IS 1893 zone polygons (data.gov.in), NRSC/NDEM flood inundation 1998–2022 and IMD's 2023 cyclone district list. Urban waterlogging is not captured. Not a pricing input on its own.
hzv.title: Declared vs official hazards
hzv.matched: Assessments with a recognised PIN code
hzv.understated: Seismic zone understated in the proposal
hzv.flood: Flood history at the PIN code
hzv.note: Every proposal's PIN code is checked against official hazard data in the nightly pipeline.
paper.title: Fill on paper, assess online
paper.lead: For proposers who find a web form hard: print the form, fill it by hand, photograph page 2 and let the AI read it. A person checks every value before the assessment runs.
paper.print_help: Two A4 pages in the language you have chosen, with English underneath. Page 1 has personal details and stays with you. Page 2 has the property and risk details and is the only page you upload.
paper.keep_page1: Keep this page. Do not photograph or upload it.
paper.upload_page2: Photograph only this page and upload it to Imaarat.
paper.declaration: I declare that the details on both pages are true to the best of my knowledge.
paper.digits_hint: Write one digit per box for the PIN code. Write amounts in rupees, digits only. Leave a box empty if you do not know.
paper.upload_help: Take the photo in good light, flat and straight, with all four corner marks visible.
paper.consent: I understand this demo reads the photo with Google's free Gemini API, which may use uploads to improve Google's products, so the photo must not show personal details.
paper.read_failed: The form could not be read. Try a clearer photo or type the details instead.
paper.ai_off: AI form reading is switched off on this demo. You can still print the form, and the details can be typed into a new assessment.
paper.review_help: Compare each value with the photo and correct it if needed. Confirm the PIN code, year built and amounts before you continue ({pending} left to confirm).
paper.issue_not_an_option: Not one of the form's options
paper.model_note: Read by {model}. Handwriting accuracy has not been measured yet, so every value needs a human check.
paper.prefilled: These values came from a paper form. Check every field, then assess.
